commonOrientation.system: 你执行图像分类任务，只输出符合要求的JSON对象。
commonOrientation.prompt: 只读取棋盘上印刷的数字，不分析棋子或棋局。第一张是完整棋盘，第二张是它的左上角放大图。在topLeftRank中原样填写左上角印刷的行号：看到数字1填1，看到数字8填8；没有印刷数字或看不清填null。不要根据棋子分布猜数字。turn仅有明确回合文字才w或b，否则null。只输出JSON对象，仅含topLeftRank和turn，不输出方向、解释或其他字段。

rawOutput.turn: w, b, or null only with explicit textual turn evidence

normalization.rank: integer 1 or exact string 1 -> b; integer 8 or exact string 8 -> w; null -> unknown
normalization.invalidRank: no direction inferred; raw contract failure remains a failure in scoring
normalization.unknownOrientation: requires human confirmation; never infer from piece distribution

classification.system: 你是国际象棋棋盘识别助手，只输出 JSON，不输出任何解释。
classification.prompt: 64张小图已经由程序切成单个格子，每张前的文本给出index=1至64（按图像从上到下、从左到右）。逐张只辨认该格是否有棋子，以及棋子颜色和类型；不要重新计算格子位置，不分析棋局或合法性。忽略数字、字母、高亮和阴影，空格不列出。白棋用PNBRQK，黑棋用pnbrqk，确实无法辨认用?。仅输出JSON对象，只有cells字段；cells是非空格对象数组，每个对象仅含整数index和单字符piece。每个index最多一次。不输出朝向、回合、坐标或解释。完成单格辨认后直接输出。
classification.contextText: 完整棋盘，仅提供棋子外观上下文；位置以后面单格图的index为准。
inputOrder: for visual indices 1 through 64: index text followed by corresponding crop image
classification.output: cells array of {index, piece}; omitted indices are empty
classification.validation: unique integer indices1..64; . and null normalize to empty; ? is unknown; piece letters are case-sensitive

imagePreparation.wholeImage: longest edge1120, no enlargement, smaller Pillow PNG or JPEG quality82
imagePreparation.coordinateCrop: auto-detected top-left 0.3 cell width/height, nearest resize256x256

parsing.note: The initial four-board run scored the string8 response as a strict failure; string normalization was separately diagnosed and frozen before the twelve-image evaluation.

classification.system: 你是国际象棋棋盘识别助手，只输出 JSON，不输出任何解释。
classification.prompt: 这些单格图片由程序筛选，可能含有棋子，每张前的index是固定原始格号。必须为每个提供的index恰好输出一次，禁止省略、增加或更改index；只判断颜色和类型。白棋PNBRQK，黑棋pnbrqk，无法辨认用?，确认为空用.；不要输出null。完整棋盘只用于外观上下文，不分析棋局、不重算位置。只输出JSON对象，只有cells字段；cells为对象数组，每个对象恰好包含整数index和单字符piece。不输出朝向、回合、解释或其他字段。
classification.contextText: 完整棋盘，仅提供棋子外观上下文；位置以后面单格图的index为准。
inputOrder: for each pixel-detected occupied candidate index: original index text followed by corresponding crop image
classification.output: cells array of {index, piece}; every supplied index must occur exactly once
classification.validation: exact supplied-index set, no duplicates; one character from .?PNBRQKpnbrqk; null prohibited
classification.review: dot on a locally occupied candidate is disputed and requires review; question mark is unknown, not a calibrated confidence score

imagePreparation.geometry: browser pixel-detected grid and occupancy; no fixture ground-truth geometry
imagePreparation.wholeImage: longest edge1120, no enlargement, smaller Pillow PNG or JPEG quality82
imagePreparation.coordinateCrop: same top-left-only crop as D; no bottom-left image

classification.system: 你执行图像分类任务，只输出符合要求的JSON对象。
classification.prompt: 判断图中单个国际象棋棋子的颜色和类型。P兵、N马、B象、R车、Q后、K王；白棋用大写，黑棋用小写。确认为空用.，无法辨认用?。忽略背景、坐标和高亮。只输出包含piece字段的JSON对象，值必须为.?PNBRQKpnbrqk中的一个字符。
classification.output: one JSON object with exactly the piece field, one character from .?PNBRQKpnbrqk
classification.association: caller associates each response with its original index; the model receives no index and no full-board image

imagePreparation.geometry: same browser pixel-detected grid and occupancy
imagePreparation.tiles: Pillow PNG enlarged with LANCZOS to longest edge256, preserving aspect ratio

scheduling.boardTiming: wait for all single-square requests and the independent orientation request

evidencePolicy.saved: final structured answers, usage, timings, finish reason, error positions and hashes
